test a forward-selection based weighted combination to capture complementary models given unstable ranking and many correlated groups.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a meta‑model weight could capture cross‑model patterns.
Try a weighted combination on the stable 7‑model pool using inverse_error weights to see if a simpler weight scheme beats the current best while keeping the subset robust.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w7' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9255. Series context: trend strength 0.8152 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.158); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.168.
